profile.ja: 世界各地に支部を持つロシアンマフィア「ホテルモスクワ」のロアナプラ支部の女ボス。若き頃、オリンピック射撃種目の選手を目指し、旧ソ連空挺軍に入隊したが、アフガニスタン侵攻に出征させられてしまう。火傷顔（フライフェイス）、全身の火傷跡はその戦線の時に負ったものらしい。主な部下はそのとき共に戦った遊撃隊のメンバーから構成されている。
profile.en: She is the female boss of the Roanapura branch of the Russian mafia "Hotel Moskva", which has branches all over the world. In her youth, she aimed to be an Olympic shooting athlete and joined the former Soviet airborne troops, but was sent to fight in the Afghan invasion. Her burned face and full-body burn scars are said to have been sustained during that time. Her main subordinates are composed of members of the reconnaissance team who fought alongside her back then.

text.ja: 久しぶりね小太郎。ふふ、どうした驚いた様な顔をして。さあ、作戦開始だ気合いを入れろ！
text.en: Long time no see, Kotaro. Haha, what's with the surprised look? Alright, let's get started with the operation - let's do this!

text.ja: 前のドレスよりもこちらの方がしっくりくるわ。ふふ、だからと言ってそんなに緊張しなくてもいいわよ
text.en: I think this dress suits me better than the last one. Haha, but don't be so nervous, okay?

text.ja: 私の付き人を務めていた頃よりどれだけ成長しているのか、見せて貰うのが楽しみね
text.en: I'm looking forward to seeing how much you've grown since you were my attendant.

text.ja: アサギとは未だに定期的に連絡はとっているわよ。組織としての連携が必要な場面がいつあるか分からないから
text.en: I still keep in touch with Asagi from time to time. You never know when we'll need to coordinate as organizations.

text.ja: 以前よりもさらに部隊が大所帯になったようね……指揮官として、どう責任を負うのかをしっかり考えるように
text.en: Your team seems to have grown even bigger... as a commander, make sure you think carefully about how to take responsibility.

text.ja: 私達には対魔忍の様な術はないけれど、武器と意思による力は劣っているとは思わないわ
text.en: We may not have the same abilities as the Taimanin, but I don't think our power, based on weapons and will, is any weaker.

text.ja: 小太郎も周囲の者が何人も亡くなっているのでしょう？　生き残ったお前はその分の思いを背負いなさい
text.en: Kotaro, you must have lost many people around you too, right? You, who have survived, must bear the weight of their memories.

text.ja: 久々の対魔忍との仕事だけど……やっぱり皆すごい格好をしてるわね。動きやすいと言われたらその通りなのだろうけど……
text.en: It's been a while since I've worked with the Taimanin... and as always, they look amazing. I've been told their outfits are easy to move around in, and I suppose that's true...
